info.title: Tenzing API
info.description:
## Overview

The **Tenzing API** is Tenzing Technologies' payroll and HR platform API. It exposes employer, employee, payroll, pension, absence, and reporting resources used to integrate with Tenzing's core system.

## Base URL & versioning

Every path is prefixed with a version segment, e.g. `/v1/employers/{employerId}/...`. Replace `{version}` with the API version you have been provisioned on (currently `v1`) when constructing requests.

## Authentication

This API uses **Bearer token (JWT)** authentication. Include the token on every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer <your-jwt-token>
```

Requests made without a valid token, or with an expired token, receive a `401 Unauthorized` response.

## Response envelope

Most endpoints return a consistent JSON envelope rather than a bare payload:

```json
{
  "isSuccess": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": null,
  "result": { }
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `isSuccess` | boolean | Whether the request completed successfully. |
| `statusCode` | integer | HTTP status code mirrored in the body. |
| `message` | string \| null | Human-readable detail, typically populated on failure. |
| `result` | object | The actual payload for the endpoint — a single object, or a list for collection endpoints. |

Always check `isSuccess` (and HTTP status) before reading `result`.

## Resources

The API is organized by resource below — employers and their nested records (employees, contracts, pay elements, pension, absence, HMRC, etc.), plus account, community, and system-level endpoints. Use the sidebar to browse by resource. Each endpoint's description lists its path/query parameters, request body schema, and response schema exactly as declared in the underlying API contract.
